title: The First Home
notes: Classical narrations say Adam and Hawwa were sent down to different places and later found each other again; many place their meeting at ʿArafat.
art: The shelter, the first harvest and the cooking fire are imagined to show the first settled life.
imagePrompt: Extreme wide shot of an empty valley just before sunrise, the sky graded from deep indigo to pale saffron, at least four layered ink-wash mountain ridges each lighter and hazier than the one in front, low mist over a winding river that mirrors the sky, dust motes drifting upward, long golden god-rays across the valley floor; two tiny figures of soft white-gold light walking side by side along the riverbank, seen from behind; a domed shelter of stone and branches, a field turning from dry earth to rippling golden wheat, a single cooking fire and a thin ribbon of grey smoke; earthy ochre, olive, warm brown and soft gold.

beats.say: On earth, Adam and Hawwa found each other again and walked together through an empty valley.
Day after day they built a shelter of stone and branches.
They broke the soil, and the first green came up.
Then the wheat turned gold, and the first fire was lit.

verse.en: …and you will have upon the earth a place of settlement and provision for a time.
